findings.statement: The capacity-gap model is a retrospective endpoint reference after invalidated strain grouping; it is not independent biological confirmation.

reliability.rationale: The retained evidence supports the stated narrow conclusion under Whole source laboratories; two development labs and one historically exposed GSK cohort; exact actual times and numeric equality targets only. mechanism.rationale: Capacitylimited kinetics is not identified by nearconstant 24 hendpoints. Calibrationsensitivity algebra demonstrates this boundary; it is not fresh biological evidence.

novelty.rationale: Source already investigates multicenter virulence; endpointselection/identifiability audit is valuable but not a new pathogen law. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.
